messages:
prateek: Quick follow-up idea: we need a compact "local-proxy" manifest for Private runtimes that only kicks in when the control plane is unreachable. Goal: explicit opt-in capability, no control-plane takeover. Thoughts?

samira: Strong +1. Explicit manifest avoids surprise behavior. Also need clear telemetry defaults (eg audit_forwarding: best_effort).

alex: Proposed minimal manifest (written locally by runtime at bootstrap, validated by control plane when reachable):

```json
{
  "capabilities": { "local_proxy": true, "streaming": false, "kms_passthrough": "required" },
  "model_pin": "rwd-gpt-lite-v1",
  "max_batch_ms": 40
}
```

Keep it intentionally tiny so hosted semantics don't leak into Private.

dina: If kms_passthrough is allowed we need an explicit key-wrapping flow doc and what telemetry the control plane can see. Also expose `audit_forwarding: best_effort` so customers know logs may be dropped.

infra-bot: DeployBot: private-runtime/rt-42 missed heartbeat at 4801234602 — local-proxy active.

marie: For fallback semantics: circuit-breaker flips after control-plane unreachable for >2m -> "offline-serving" using the manifest. If a request needs an unsupported op (eg function-calling when streaming=false) return 422 with machine-parsable body including `fallback_hint`. SDKs should interpret and surface this.

prateek: API change suggestion: add header `X-Redwood-Env: private-local` and standardize error shape: `\{\"error\":\"unsupported_operation\",\"reason\":\"streaming_not_available\",\"fallback\":\"hosted:rwd-gpt-lite-v1\"}`. Also add an SDK mapping PR to handle 422 gracefully.

alex: Example HTTP response we can standardize for unsupported ops:
HTTP/1.1 422 Unsupported-Operation
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"unsupported_operation","reason":"streaming_not_available","fallback":"hosted:rwd-gpt-lite-v1"}

samira: Rollout plan: canary on Dedicated first (they have HA), add e2e harness that simulates control-plane loss so we validate semantics before wider Private rollout.

dina: Ops runbook snippet: how to flip circuit-breaker back when control-plane returns, logs to look for (eg `local_proxy=active`, manifest checksum), and customer-facing messaging.

prateek: Action items: 1) I'll draft short RFC with manifest shape, error contract, and runbook. 2) @alex PR for SDK 422 mapping. 3) @samira own canary list and test scenarios.

marie: +1  also add privacy note about telemetry redaction when `audit_forwarding` is `best_effort` so legal can sign off.

samira: ack.

prateek: I'll drop the RFC link here once it's up. Thanks all. :rocket:
